RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 30

The panel's composition is not evidence of anything. Panels skew by department demographics and administrative availability; an all-woman panel is no more probative of bias than an all-man one, and raising it will read as an accusation you can't support — which damages your credibility on the point that actually has force.

That point is the record: PhD complete vs. in progress, six papers vs. two. Ask about that, neutrally and in writing.

Also pursue the overdue explanation through the proper channel — HR, the appointing authority, or a freedom-of-information request if it's a public institution. Many jurisdictions require disclosure of selection criteria and scoring.

Your 30% reflects an unexplained credential gap, not the panel.
